outcome.description: The loop's next state. `finish` may not coexist with a `write` disposition or an open question for David.

should_this_exist.description: The step-back on the change as a whole, not on any one finding.

should_this_exist_reason.description: Why, in one or two sentences a product owner can read.

next_action.description: One line: what should happen next. A recommendation, not a decision.

findings.description: One entry per finding you were given, all of them, keyed by the id in the input.

id.description: The finding's id, exactly as the input gave it.

disposition.description: write: fix it. decline: a real defect shipped knowingly, becoming a recorded gap. no_change_needed: the finding is wrong, duplicated or already covered. to_david: only he can decide. not_judged: you could not judge this one, which binds the builder to nothing and requires outcome insufficient_context.

worth.description: Class-level reasoning in one or two sentences: who supplies the value, and likelihood against consequence for the class rather than the reported instance.

correction.description: For `write`, the bounded change to make. Empty string for every other disposition.

acceptance_check.description: For `write`, a condition someone can actually observe once the fix is in. Empty string for every other disposition.

batch_assessment.description: The batch as a whole: is it repairing one mechanism or growing one, does it sit in code an earlier fix in this loop changed, and what a further review round of it would cost.

product_decisions_for_david.description: Questions only David can answer. Empty is the common case.

question.description: Plain English, no jargon, answerable without reading code.

options.description: Two or more, each with its consequence.

recommendation.description: Which option you would take, and why.

verified_claims.description: What you checked yourself, each naming the file or command that settled it.

unable_to_verify.description: What you could not check, each naming what would settle it.

summary_for_david.description: Three plain sentences for someone who will never see the code.

reviewed_commit.description: The commit you judged, exactly as the input gave it.
